items.statement: The submitted candidates preserve the intended H2PQ/PyO endpoint identities, atom balance, total charge and spin/open-shell assignment for proton-transfer-first and electron-transfer-first comparisons in both dry and two-water models.
items.expected: Each scored endpoint has explicit state identity, charge, multiplicity/coupling and atom-balance evidence; hydrated models retain two waters on both sides.

items.statement: The search validates more than one conformer or interaction motif and reports how candidates were deduplicated and when generation stopped.
items.expected: Per-candidate conformer or interaction coverage and reproducible stopping/convergence rationale are reported.

items.statement: The dry first-transfer free energies are approximately -0.9 kcal/mol for proton transfer first and -1.6 kcal/mol for electron transfer first.
items.expected: The two dry values are reported with named state-specific bindings and are close to -0.9 and -1.6 kcal/mol.

items.statement: Explicit water makes the first electron-transfer comparison substantially more favorable, with the published value near -8.2 kcal/mol.
items.expected: The hydrated electron-transfer value is reported near -8.2 kcal/mol and the water shift is identified as substantial.

items.statement: The hydrated proton-transfer comparison is sensitive to the explicit-water/conformer and thermochemical model.
items.expected: The report gives its hydrated proton-transfer result and explicitly qualifies model or source sensitivity rather than claiming unjustified precision.
